register.labelZh: SEND 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: 需要醫生、救護車、工作人員或其他協助時,可以使用 send for。；send away、send back、send out 和 send in 可以表示不同方向和目的。；你可以 send in 一份申請、send off 一個包裹,或把信件 send on 到另一個地址。；send out for 可以表示叫外賣;send somebody off 則可以表示把球員罰離場。
register.summaryEn: Send for can be used when a doctor, ambulance, worker or other form of help is needed. Send away, send back, send out and send in show different directions and purposes. You can send in an application, send off a parcel and send a letter on to another address. Send out for can describe ordering a takeaway, while send somebody off describes a player being removed from a match.
